name: shadow
style: A shadow-puppet theatre film: crisp black cut-paper silhouettes with delicate cut-out details moving against a softly glowing warm paper screen, layered translucent coloured tissue in amber, rose and deep blue, visible paper grain, gentle hand-moved puppet motion.
picture_style: Style: a shadow-puppet theatre image, crisp black cut-paper silhouettes with delicate cut-out details against a softly glowing warm paper screen, visible paper grain.
voice: A woman with a hushed, warm, bedtime-story voice

child.draw: The black cut-paper silhouette of one small child sitting up in bed in profile facing right, with messy hair, a nightshirt and the blanket pulled up to the chin, on a plain softly glowing amber paper screen with nothing else around.
child.is: the black paper silhouette of the small child with messy hair sitting up in bed with the blanket pulled up

monster.draw: The black cut-paper silhouette of a tall looming shadow monster on a plain deep blue glowing paper screen: long clawed arms raised, spiky back, two round cut-out eyes and a jagged cut-out mouth, made of ragged torn paper edges.
monster.is: the tall black paper shadow monster with long clawed arms, a spiky back and round cut-out eyes

lamp.draw: A real photograph, not a silhouette: a small modern bedside lamp standing on a wooden bedside table in a dark child's bedroom at night, a rounded mushroom shape with a frosted white dome shade and a short brushed-brass base, glowing warm amber. Its light throws onto the wall behind it the large soft shadows of two hands making a rabbit shadow puppet and of a small paper star mobile. Part of a bed with a patterned blanket at the edge.
lamp.is: the small mushroom-shaped bedside lamp with a frosted white dome and brass base glowing amber on a bedside table, throwing a rabbit hand-shadow on the wall

clips.sound: A dark quiet house at night, wind outside, a floorboard creak, a small frightened gasp.

shots.text: On a dim deep-blue paper screen {child}, wide awake, head turning left and right, the silhouette of a window with a crescent moon behind.
the black paper silhouettes of ordinary bedroom things, a coat on a hook, a chair with clothes, a branch outside the window, slowly stretching and twisting upward into frightening pointed shapes.
{monster} rising up over the little bed, its long arms spreading across the whole blue screen.

clips.sound: A soft click, a warm gentle hum, then a surprised giggle and a playful little squeak.

shots.text: {child} reaching one small silhouette hand out to the side, and a warm amber glow blooming from the edge of the screen and washing the deep blue away.
in the warm amber light {monster} shrinking and softening, its claws curling into round paws and its spikes into floppy ears, until it is a plump friendly paper bear silhouette giving a shy wave.
{child} now laughing and bouncing on the bed while friendly paper silhouettes parade across the glowing amber screen: the bear, a rabbit, a giraffe and a little whale swimming through paper stars.

clips.sound: Quiet bedtime calm, slow sleepy breathing, a faint lullaby hum of the lamp.

shots.text: {child} lying down and falling asleep under the blanket while the paper bear silhouette sits beside the bed keeping watch, paper stars turning slowly above.
the camera pulling back from the glowing paper screen until it is seen to be a real bedroom wall at night, the shadows on it cast by {lamp}.
a close view of {lamp}, its amber light breathing gently, the soft bear-shaped shadow on the wall behind it giving one last small wave.
